name: server-commit-history
title: Server Commit History
description: A CommitHistory over a PageSource: older commits load as the end scrolls into view and from a Load more button, the header counts the source's total, and the graph carries on across pages.
docs: `<ServerCommitHistory aria-label source filter labels={{ errorTitle, retry, emptyTitle }} />` inside a `DataProvider`. `source` is any `PageSource<Commit>` (`cursorSource` for a `git log` API that returns a cursor, `pagedSource`, or `arraySource` in memory) and `filter` what it filters on, like `{ branch }`: a new filter starts again from the newest commit. `pageSize` (100) commits per request through `useServerInfinite`; `DataState` covers loading, error with retry and empty. Every other `CommitHistory` prop passes through.
